research.method: All values come from FIBA's official statistics service behind fiba.basketball (the public data API the site's history pages call). For every team the player list comes from getgdapcompetitionteamstatisticsbyteamid; each player's totals are the sum of his per-game rows from getgdapplayergamestatisticsbyplayerid, restricted to the 3 games of this tournament listed by getgdapgamesbycompetitionid. Birth dates come from getgdapplayerinfobycompetitionid (fallback: the team roster). FIBA records minutes in whole minutes for these events.
research.add_up_check: Each team's summed player points equal the points in its game scores (difference listed per team in team_totals[].check).
research.bbr_matching: bbr_id is set only for keys of library/careers/nba_player_careers.json with an NBA season in 2003-04, 2004-05 or 2005-06, matched by name and then reviewed by hand (birth date and team) for every hand-made match; players whose NBA careers ended before 2003-04 have no careers key and keep bbr_id null (noted on the record).
research.minutes_reconciliation: FIBA rounds each player's minutes to whole minutes, so a team's game total can be 1-2 minutes off 200 (or 225/250 with overtime). Every team's minutes reconcile to 200 a game plus whole overtime periods within rounding.
